line: Unpaid household services, such as caring for children and adults, cooking, laundry and transport, are outside what GDP and GNI count, so none of the measures here includes them. Most of this work is done by women. For the UK, the Office for National Statistics values them at £1.5 trillion in 2024, equal to 52% of GDP (Household Satellite Account, UK: 2024 and provisional 2025 estimates).
source: Office for National Statistics, Household Satellite Account, UK: 2024 (and provisional 2025) estimates, released 24 November 2026
